name: What factors influence the lifespan of tile flooring?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the lifespan of tile flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of tile flooring is influenced by several factors, including the quality of the tile and installation, the amount of foot traffic, and ongoing maintenance. High-quality porcelain or natural stone tiles installed correctly can last for decades. Proper subfloor preparation, correct thin-set application, and appropriate grouting are crucial for longevity. Regular cleaning and prompt repair of any damage also contribute significantly to extending the life of your tile floor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile flooring lifespan depends on tile quality, proper installation, foot traffic, and maintenance. High-quality tiles with correct installation can last for decades.
